   "source": [
    "<div style=\"text-align: center;\"><strong>PH 364 Final Project: Beat Frequencies: Code Review</strong></div>\n",
    "<div style=\"text-align: center;\"><strong>Carter Hunt</strong></div> \n",
    "\n",
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "The tool that I have chosen to review for the individual code review assignment that was used in my group's final project is the IPython.display.Audio function inside the IPython.display module of the IPython library that is made for generating interactive interfaces within code."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "53b520ea-a6e9-4ef6-9e41-fc5274b3d300",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The .Audio function of the display library was used to audibly play a superposition of waves that was made in our project so that listeners could hear the beats that are generated by 2 or more waves superimposed upon each other. The function was used to illustrate how the waves that are superimposed can change the frequency of beats generated in a resulting wave and how more than two waves can introduce more than one beat frequency to a resulting wave. More than two waves can cause a seemingly asymmetrical wave of frequencies made up of the different beat frequencies and cause the beats heard in a superimposed wave to seem erratic. An example of this can be heard from code pulled from the final project below:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "7ea75d70-539e-4696-9293-ea5fc7a1bb63",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from IPython.display import Audio as ad"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "8a092abb-3a82-4600-8102-385bbf6ae8b1",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "freqs = [400, 402, 407, 408]\n",
    "sampling_rate = 44100\n",
    "duration = 10.0\n",
    "t = np.linspace(0, duration, int(sampling_rate * duration), endpoint=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "fc52022f-7d0e-4c4f-9b5d-38c9aacada03",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "\n",
       "                <audio  controls=\"controls\" >\n",
       "                    <source src=\"data:audio/wav;base64,\" type=\"audio/wav\" />\n",
       "                    Your browser does not support the audio element.\n",
       "                </audio>\n",
       "              "
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.lib.display.Audio object>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 13,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from IPython.display import Audio as ad\n",
    "\n",
    "superpos = sum(np.sin(2 * np.pi * f * t) for f in freqs)\n",
    "\n",
    "ad(superpos, rate = 44100)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ec8c856e-59b8-4ff2-8222-e1cc46f71bfb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The audio function used above is imported as ad to make calling it in code more efficient. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e9ab0dba-35b7-46cb-8739-fb02fa56d589",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The code structure of the Audio function is as follows:\n",
    "\n",
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "IPython.display.Audio(data=None, filename=None, url=None, embed=None, rate=None, autoplay=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "but the main nuance can be found in the most basic necessary paramter, which is to specify the rate of playback. Changing the sampling rate of the audio changes the frequency and length of the resulting audio playback. It changes the rate at which the data stored to be played as audio is played, and if not held constant or checked for correctness can change audio from its intended sound to something else. An example with the same data from above can be found below:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "d0e34964-5a14-4d94-80d5-da0318b333be",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "\n",
       "                <audio  controls=\"controls\" >\n",
       "                    <source src=\"data:audio/wav;base64,\" type=\"audio/wav\" />\n",
       "                    Your browser does not support the audio element.\n",
       "                </audio>\n",
       "              "
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "<IPython.lib.display.Audio object>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 11,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ad(superpos, rate = 10000)"
   ]
  },
